title: Isometric images: Borel, Hᵏ-measure and change of variables
statement: Let P, k ∈ ℕ, let Φ : ℝ^k → ℝ^P be an isometry for the Euclidean metrics and let A ⊆ ℝ^k be Borel. Then Φ(A) is Borel, Hᵏ(Φ(A)) = Lᵏ(A), and ∫_{Φ(A)} h dHᵏ = ∫_A h(Φ(y)) dy for every function h : ℝ^P → ℝ. Here Hᵏ = μHE[k] is the normalized Hausdorff measure, Lᵏ = volume is Lebesgue measure on ℝ^k = Euclid k, and the integrals are Bochner integrals (both 0 when not integrable).
lean_statement: ∀ (P k : ℕ) (Φ : Euclid k → Euclid P) (A : Set (Euclid k)), Isometry Φ → MeasurableSet A → MeasurableSet (Φ '' A) ∧ μHE[k] (Φ '' A) = volume A ∧ ∀ h : Euclid P → ℝ, ∫ x in Φ '' A, h x ∂μHE[k] = ∫ y in A, h (Φ y)
